identity.description:
Move the cases pin and write the D4b baseline at two repeats

The final D4b PR: one pin move and one baseline for all four revisions.

## What changes

- `eval/cases.json`: the pin moves to `373266b` of the cases repo: 28 cases and 186 goldens, from R1 (benchmark), R2 (own-repo pool), R3 (dismissed findings) and R4 (injection).
- `eval/baseline.json`: the first baseline at two repeats, written with `--write-baseline` at tool version 0.10.0.
- `test/eval-pin.test.ts`: the baseline `cases_ref` must equal the pin, and the baseline must have two repeats or more.
- `TICKETS.md`: the D4b entry records the baseline.

## The baseline

| Metric | Mean | Min | Max |
|--------|------|-----|-----|
| Recall | 0.542 | 0.519 | 0.565 |
| Precision | 0.598 | 0.584 | 0.612 |
| Adjudicated precision | 0.674 | 0.644 | 0.704 |
| Raw recall | 0.640 | 0.630 | 0.649 |
| Cost per case | $4.66 | $4.57 | $4.75 |
| Judge cost per case | $0.09 | $0.08 | $0.10 |

## The margins

The README rule takes the spread (mean minus min), doubles it, rounds it up to a multiple of 0.05, and uses at least 0.05.

- Recall: 0.542 − 0.519 = 0.023; twice that is 0.046; the margin is 0.05.
- Precision: 0.598 − 0.584 = 0.014; twice that is 0.028; the margin is 0.05.

Both margins sit 0.05 or more below the baseline values. This is the first baseline at two repeats, so no earlier spread exists to compare. Two calm repeats can understate the noise, so a later routine run that fails the gate by a small amount says to check the spread before it says the change is bad.

## The run

The eval and the CI reviewer use the same plan login, and a baseline at two repeats does not fit in one five-hour window. The run used `eval --resume` in five batches over four plan windows, and it stopped each batch by a dollar limit. It cost $265.90 in all, and no repeat failed. 30 extras judge queries gave no answer, so those findings count as false in the strict and the adjudicated precision.

## Verification

- `npm test` (1423 tests), `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
- No shipped file changes, so no version bump.
